info.about: Wet is a 2009 third-person shooter action game, developed by Artificial Mind & Movement and published by Bethesda Softworks for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360.
info.trivia: Activision Blizzard dropped it along with many other games in July 2008, and Bethesda Softworks went on to publish it.
info.why: A sequel announced in 2010 was cancelled, so the original remains the only Wet.
